title: Mixing Properties of Random Laguerre Tessellations
summary: In this paper, we study the random Laguerre tessellation, a weighted generalization of the Voronoi tessellation, generated by a general stationary marked point process. We first derive a nearly optimal sufficient condition on the generating marked point process which ensures that the resulting random Laguerre tessellation is well-defined, utilising the concept of tempered configurations to handle potentially unbounded weights.
